headline: Bitcoin slides below $82k, testing $79.5k support as market pivots to altcoin risk‑on
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC formed a descending channel, breaking the 81,200 $ resistance and eyeing the 79,500 $ support zone; the 4H shows a higher‑low hold at 80,200 $ but bearish pressure persists.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑beta alts, with WAL, SOXSB and GLMR leading gains, indicating a risk‑on tilt after Bitcoin’s pullback.
strategy_outlook: Spot traders should consider buying on dips near $79.5k with tight stops; futures players may short the next rally above $81.2k on a 1‑2% profit target.
